sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-29 and 2016-12-29, card C08106-K1 belonging to customer C08106 was subject to unauthorized transactions totaling $128.33 USD. The activity was categorized under pattern 'card_not_present_new_device', conducted via online channel. Cardholder verification confirmed that the cardholder did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of the card. Investigation of the associated infrastructure identified device profile ' |  | firefox 47.0 | ', which is linked to 5 other cardholder accounts (C03095-K2, C07518-K2, C04248-K2), indicating a coordinated compromise. In accordance with Bank Fraud Policy Rule R2, a Suspicious Activity Report is filed. Card C08106-K1 has been blocked and connected accounts placed under enhanced monitoring.

stop_reason: Customer verification settled the verdict; evidence sufficient under policy stopping criteria.
